title: Come From
situation: Finding the source of a machine problem.
objective: Use come from to ask and explain where something comes from.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Where does the problem come from?

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: This is the first question I ask.
dialogue.indonesian: Ini pertanyaan pertama yang saya ajukan.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Sometimes the problem comes from a loose cable.
dialogue.indonesian: Terkadang masalahnya berasal dari kabel yang longgar.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Sometimes it comes from a dirty sensor.
dialogue.indonesian: Terkadang berasal dari sensor yang kotor.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: The new spare part comes from the warehouse, and it usually comes in a small box.
dialogue.indonesian: Suku cadang baru datang dari gudang, dan biasanya dikemas dalam kotak kecil.

learningNotes: come from dipakai untuk menjelaskan asal sesuatu: comes from a loose cable.
Pertanyaan dengan does: Where does the problem come from?
comes memakai -s karena subjeknya the problem atau it.
